All products

How we make our oil

1

Select seeds

We pick clean, sun dried groundnut, sesame, coconut and other seeds.

2

Press in the ghani

Seeds are crushed slowly in a wooden ghani, so the oil never gets hot.

3

Filter and bottle

The oil settles, is filtered naturally and is filled into bottles the same day.
